title: Ensemble of Convolutional Neural Networks for StrokePrediction: Towards Improved Diagnostic Accuracy
abstract: arXiv:2608.24771v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Brain stroke, known for its high mortality and incidence rates, poses significant health risks and requires rapid intervention for survival. Early diagnosis and preventive measures can greatly reduce life loss and disabilities. Recent advancements in deep learning have led to novel computer-aided diagnostic techniques for early stroke detection. This study proposes an intelligent system that predicts potential strokes using eleven features, evaluated through seven supervised machine learning algorithms. The process includes a literature review, dataset visualization, data preprocessing, and model evaluation. Ensemble methods like Random Forest, Stacking Classifier, and Bagging Classifier achieved high accuracies of 99.52%, while Decision Tree reached 98.24%. translated_title: 基于卷积神经网络集成方法的脑卒中预测：迈向更高诊断准确性
translated_abstract: 脑卒中以高死亡率和发病率著称，对健康构成重大风险，需要快速干预以挽救生命。早期诊断和预防措施可显著减少生命损失和残疾。近年来，深度学习的进步催生了用于早期卒中检测的新型计算机辅助诊断技术。本研究提出一种智能系统，利用十一个特征预测潜在卒中，并通过七种监督机器学习算法进行评估。过程包括文献综述、数据集可视化、数据预处理和模型评估。集成方法如随机森林、堆叠分类器和装袋分类器达到了99.52%的高准确率，而决策树达到98.24%。其他模型，包括KNN和TabNet，表现出可靠性能，分别达到96.73%和96.49%的准确率。自定义前馈模型达到94.91%。
tldr: 本研究提出一种基于集成学习方法的智能卒中预测系统，利用十一个特征和七种监督学习算法，实现了高达99.52%的诊断准确率，显著提升了早期卒中检测的可靠性。
en_tdlr: This study proposes an intelligent stroke prediction system using ensemble learning methods with eleven features and seven supervised algorithms, achieving up to 99.52% diagnostic accuracy, significantly enhancing early stroke detection reliability.
